page.overview:
Who is Gorch?

Admiral Gorch was a male Tellarite Starfleet flag officer in the mid-23rd century. ()

Following the near-defeat of the United Federation of Planets in the , Gorch was among Admiral Katrina Cornwell's retinue. When the returned from the mirror universe, Gorch, together with Shukar, boarded the ship and secured the bridge before Cornwell and Ambassador Sarek transported aboard. ()

After the cessation of hostilities, Gorch was present in Paris on Earth when the crew of the Discovery was honored for their role in ending the war. ()

Gorch was played by actor Harry Judge. Gorch was the first Tellarite Starfleet officer to appear on screen. The prime universe Gorch appeared on screen only after his mirror universe counterpart.
